entries.claim_boundary: This is an exact obstruction to the proposed round-style scalar Hodge subcomplex on the selected Berger background, not a defect of q70, a physical instability, or an obstruction to complete SU(2)_L x U(1)_R isotypical blocks. The k=0 exceptional family remains open.

dispersion.statement: The proposed scalar restriction is not a subcomplex: d1 q[bar_c_star_diff,c_spatial] d0 has leading coefficient 93 i k omega^2/40 for every k nonzero.

lee_wald.statement: No physical quotient exists on the nonclosed proposed carrier, so the cyclic BV pairing cannot yet descend to a scalar Gram matrix.

resonance.statement: Characteristic roots and Jordan chains are not defined before a closed isotypical or gauge-adapted carrier is constructed.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: The obstruction is unary and precedes a scalar tangent-cone calculation.

causal_retarded.statement: The full q70 parent remains causal, but its Green identity cannot be restricted to this nonclosed scalar carrier.

smooth_secular.statement: Only the separate homogeneous global action-angle sector has a certified secular family tangent.

taub_maps.statement: No scalar physical cohomology class is exported on which a Taub map could be evaluated.

scope.background: stationary biaxial Berger R x S3, a=1, c_squared=9/40
scope.carrier: proposed exact-one-form scalar Hodge subcomplex of the complete gauge-fixed 70-row parent
scope.charge_sector: unrestricted Q_rel with physical D and R_rel retained
scope.degree: spatial Diff ghost degree -1 to antighost-dual degree 0 at the first closure test
scope.k: -j,-j+1,...,j; obstruction certified for k!=0; k=0 exceptional/open
scope.omega: arbitrary time frequency; nonzero obstruction already in the omega^2 coefficient
scope.parity: scalar-derived even spatial parity; generic right weight k nonzero
